summary: Marketplace screen for any game: player listings and auctions, selling, bids, direct trades, claims and history.
description: A ready player marketplace (Unity Alikhan/Marketplace) for ANY game, built on the @idosgames/react/ui kit and client.marketplace. Tabs: the market (items grouped with their cheapest price), my lots, my bids, direct trades, things to claim and history. Everything detailed is a popup: an item's offers (cheapest listing first, then auctions ending soonest), one offer (buy, bid with the engine's minimum next bid, cancel your own), selling (pick an item — only tradable, never a worn one — then listing or auction, amount, price in a currency tradable between players, duration and the commission), and incoming trades (accept / decline). The server holds the escrow and settles every trade. Registers the 'marketplace' feature; its badge counts things to claim and trades waiting. Ships title-seed.json: listings and auctions for currencies with a 5% commission.
provides: sell popup with price and duration
bids with the minimum next bid
